newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen lower, undertone remain soft.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen lower, undertone remain soft.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil market on Tuesday were seen softer on weaker overnight crude values and renewed prompt selling with buyers at lower levels, traders said.
Centistoke 180 prices were quoted at $116-$118 per tonne on Monday for November loading supplies.
Most traders expected prices to edge down slightly from Monday's quotes. While one to two traders said fundamentals were balanced, most said there were more supplies than demand in the market.
An offer was seen for end November 20,000-tonnes at $116.50 per tonne, free-on-board Singapore against a bid at low of $113.50 per tonne.
"There are still South korean barrels in November still unsold," said a trader.
"The marginal crude gains seen early Tuesday were not expected to boost prices in an oversupplied market," a trader said.
KEDO has issued a tender to buy residual fuel oil for delivery in November. The tender will close on on Wednesday.
In the swaps market, November paper was discussed at $115.50/$116.25, lower from Friday's quotes at $116/$116.50.
